output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Costco is defending a proposed class action over whether its grain-free dog food contributes to canine heart disease; plaintiffs were opposing Costco’s dismissal bid on November 10. The newest reported filing is Howell v. Costco Wholesale Corp., filed November 6 in New York, alleging Costco passed IEEPA-tariff costs to customers through higher prices and should return the money; Costco’s fiscal-2026 filing also identifies four earlier tariff-refund suits, with the court denying Costco’s motion to dismiss in Gower. Other active or recently reported matters include the Orgain protein-powder heavy-metals case, the Kirkland electrolyte-mix/allulose labeling case, the Kirkland tequila-labeling case, employee wage-and-hour/PAGA cases, privacy-tracker litigation, opioid-related claims, and a Washington email-marketing case that Costco settled for $14 million rather than continues to litigate.
caveats: This is a current summary of the principal matters disclosed by Costco and newly reported cases, not a complete docket of every personal-injury, premises-liability, employment or other claim; Costco says it is involved in many claims and litigations.

The allegations are claims by plaintiffs, not findings that Costco violated the law. Case status can change after the November 11, 2026 cutoff; the company's Form 10-K says it does not expect any pending matter, individually or in aggregate, to have a material adverse effect, while acknowledging an unfavorable outcome could materially affect an individual quarter or year.
The $14 million email matter is included for context but is described as settled and therefore is not an ongoing merits dispute in the same sense as the other cases.

passages.quote: Dog owners on Monday told a Washington federal judge that Costco's bid to dismiss their proposed class action alleging that its grain-free dog food contributes to canine heart disease ignores their factual allegations.
Plaintiff Elizabeth Howell filed the Costco class action lawsuit on Nov. 6 in New York federal court, alleging violations of state and federal laws.
In March 2026, four class actions were filed against the Company seeking a refund of tariffs paid by the Company under IEEPA that were passed on to members through higher prices.
In a motion to dismiss a class action lawsuit, Costco argues that marketing its Orgain organic protein powder as “good, clean nutrition” was never a promise that the product was free of lead.
A new class action lawsuit accuses Costco of “health-washing” its Kirkland Signature Hydration Electrolyte Drink Mix by labeling it sugar-free despite containing allulose.
Plaintiffs allege that the Company's Kirkland Signature tequilas are labeled “100% de Agave” but contain alcohol derived from non-agave sugars.
Between September 25 and October 31, 2023, five class action suits were filed against the Company alleging privacy law violations stemming from pixel trackers on Costco.com.
Costco Wholesale Corp. will pay $14 million to resolve a class action accusing the retailer of sending advertising emails with false or misleading subject lines.

output.question: What lawsuits is Costco involved in?

key_facts.fact: Dog owners were opposing Costco's motion to dismiss a proposed class action alleging that Costco's grain-free dog food contributes to canine heart disease.

Elizabeth Howell filed Howell v. Costco Wholesale Corp., Case No. 1:26-cv-07168, in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York on November 6, 2026; the complaint alleges Costco overcharged customers for IEEPA-tariff costs and seeks a refund.

Costco's fiscal-2026 filing identifies four tariff-refund class actions—Stockov, Gower, Ortiz and Briggs—and says the Gower court denied Costco's motion to dismiss on July 17, 2026, with appellate review pending.

The Barton class action alleges Costco-sold Orgain protein powder contains undisclosed lead, cadmium and arsenic; Costco later sought dismissal, arguing its 'clean' marketing did not promise the products were free of heavy metals.
Maldonado v. Costco Wholesale Corporation, Case No. 2:26-cv-03702, alleges that Kirkland Signature Hydration Electrolyte Drink Mix was improperly labeled sugar-free despite containing allulose.

Costco's 2026 Form 10-K says the Salisbury tequila case alleges Kirkland Signature tequila labeled '100% de Agave' contains alcohol derived from non-agave sugars, and that Costco filed a motion to dismiss in April 2026.

Costco's 2026 Form 10-K reports pending employee wage/PAGA matters, remaining opioid-related claims, privacy litigation over pixel trackers on Costco.com, and a July 2026 Jay class action over allegedly misleading 'limited-time' promotional-email subject lines.
A Washington judge gave final approval to Costco's $14 million settlement of a class action alleging false or misleading advertising-email subject lines.
